title.zh: Why Nasdaq surveillance cannot settle the fight over 24/7 tokenized markets

current_state.zh: Nasdaq's $100 million investment in Kraken parent Payward and planned surveillance across five market types highlights that legal classification, not surveillance technology, will determine U.S. listing paths and investor protections for 24/7 tokenized markets.
